Other vendors’ track systems are incompatible with the motor mounting interfaces, load ratings, and software safety features required for proper GH3+ functionality. Q: Does the requirement mandate a 100% vendor-furnished rental model, or does SAVAHCS retain any existing Customer-Owned Linen Items (COLI) that the contractor will be required to process alongside rented inventory? A: A 100% vendor-furnished rental model. Q: If COLI processing is required, will the vendor be held liable for standard wear-and- tear or replacement costs for government-owned items? A: No. Q: What is the exact required Par level distribution across the health care system prior to Day 1 of contract performance (e.g., 3-Par, 4-Par, or 5-Par systemwide)? A: 3 Days. Q: What is the breakdown of initial Par stock required on-site at the SAVAHCS main campus versus off-site reserve? A: Off Site Reserve will be 96 hour contingency linen. Q: Will the VA provide an explicit physical technical specification sheet (e.g., thread count, GSM weight, fabric blend 55 / 45 cotton-poly vs. 100% barrier poly, color coding, surgical drape fluid-resistance ratings) for each line item? A: Fabric blend 55 / 45 cotton-poly vs. 100% barrier poly, color coding depending on the cost. 36C26227Q0001 Page 5 of 11 Q: Are micro-fiber mop heads, microfiber cloths, and barrier isolation gowns included in the general 1,350,000 lbs annual estimated volume, or are they counted / tracke

requirements, and designated delivery time slots for each satellite location. A: N/A. Q: Is the contractor required to supply all clean / soiled exchange carts, poly-dump carts, and wire delivery hampers? A: Contractor is required to supply all clean / soiled exchange carts. 36C26227Q0001 Page 6 of 11 Q: What are the physical dimensional constraints (height, width, depth) of the SAVAHCS logistics staging area, freight elevators, and clean linen rooms to ensure incoming contractor carts fit properly? A: Average dock dimensions for 24-foot box truck. Q: What is the minimum quantity of dedicated exchange carts required to remain on-site at SAVAHCS at all times? A: 30. Q: Is contractor performance restricted strictly to dock-to-dock exchange, or is the contractor responsible for internal ward-level replenishment / clean linen room stocking? A: Restricted strictly to dock-to-dock exchange. Q: Does the requirement mandate a 100% vendor-furnished rental model, or does SAVAHCS retain any existing Customer-Owned Linen Items (COLI) that the contractor will be required to process alongside rented inventory? A: A 100% vendor-furnished rental model. Q: If COLI processing is required, will the vendor be held liable for standard wear-and- tear or replacement costs for government-owned items? A: No. Q: What is the exact required Par level distribution across the health care system prior to Day 1 of contract performance (e.g., 3-Par, 4-Par, or 5-Par systemwide)? A: 3 Days. Q: What is the breakdown of initial Par stock required on-site at the SAVAHCS main campus versus off-site reserve? A: Off Site Reserve will be 96 hour contingency linen. Q: Will the VA provide an explicit physical technical specification sheet (e.g., thread count, GSM weight, fabric blend 55 / 45 cotton-poly vs. 100% barrier poly, color coding, surgical drape fluid-resistance ratings) for each line item? A: Fabric blend 55 / 45 cotton-poly vs. 100% barrier poly, color coding depending on the cost. 36C26227Q0001 Page 5 of 11 Q: Are micro-fiber mop heads, microfiber cloths, and barrier isolation gowns included in the general 1,350,000 lbs annual estimated volume, or are they counted / tracke

requirements, and designated delivery time slots for each satellite location. A: N/A. Q: Is the contractor required to supply all clean / soiled exchange carts, poly-dump carts, and wire delivery hampers? A: Contractor is required to supply all clean / soiled exchange carts. 36C26227Q0001 Page 6 of 11 Q: What are the physical dimensional constraints (height, width, depth) of the SAVAHCS logistics staging area, freight elevators, and clean linen rooms to ensure incoming contractor carts fit properly? A: Average dock dimensions for 24-foot box truck. Q: What is the minimum quantity of dedicated exchange carts required to remain on-site at SAVAHCS at all times? A: 30. Q: Is contractor performance restricted strictly to dock-to-dock exchange, or is the contractor responsible for internal ward-level replenishment / clean linen room stocking? A: Restricted strictly to dock-to-dock exchange.
